// Maps the bones of a source skeleton onto a target skeleton for animation
// retargeting. TargetBoneIndices is parallel to the source skeleton's bones;
// each entry is the corresponding target bone's index, or -1 when unmapped.
type RetargetMap
    implements IValue
{
    TargetBoneIndices: Array<BoneIndex>;
}
